warnings: Every S-sheet prints the box "เหล็กเสริมข้ออ้อย ทั้งหมด ให้ใช้ชั้นคุณภาพ SD 40" — so every DB bar on this sheet is SD40 (steel_grade). The RB/ø grade is not printed on this sheet.

Section sizes are read as printed: the horizontal dimension above the section = width_mm, the vertical one = height_mm. Where a beam has more than one cut (SECTION 1-1 / 2-2 ...), main_bar.top/bottom carry the governing (largest) count of the cuts and the other cut is written in that face's note (same convention as house 165).
No scale is printed on this sheet; the scan has no text layer, every value was read off zoomed crops.
